zone.name: All

zone.name: Frontal

zone.description: Union of Frontal, Temporal and Parietal (both hemispheres) — sockets 1-71, everything anterior to the parieto-occipital sulcus. This is the site list the PBM evidence calls 'whole-head': pbm_neuro_protocols.md §1 (Alzheimer's, Grade A) specifies 'bilateral frontal, temporal, parietal + midline' and §6 (chronic TBI, Grade B) specifies 'multi-site scalp (frontal/temporal/parietal)'. Neither enumerates occipital, so this zone deliberately excludes it; use 'All' only when every address really is intended. The frontal and parietal midline sockets (2, 13, 29, 46, 62) are included; the occipital midline socket (74, Oz) is not.
zone.name: Vault (excl. Occipital)

zone.description: Frontal Right with the three frontal midline sockets (2, 13, 29) omitted; every other Frontal Right socket is kept, including the half-pitch ones beside the midline. A DIS-INCLUSION zone in the sense of the PR #210 membership ruling: membership is inclusive by default, and the only way to narrow a zone is to author a narrower one — there is no runtime exclusion filter. Exists for protocols whose evidence base is genuinely right-hemisphere only; 04-memory-boost (Yao 2022, right F4) is the only such protocol today. scripts/sync-socket-map.ts holds this zone to exactly Frontal Right minus its x = 0 sockets. Re-cut 2026-09-29: until then this zone listed [3, 6, 9, 10, 14, 15, 18, 19], authored against a retired socket numbering, and four of those (6, 10, 18, 19) are left-hemisphere sockets. The contralateral-energy figures in NP-OPT-PSF-001 §4 (16.3% → 3.6%) were computed on that retired numbering; see the flag in that section for the figures on this list. The residual spill from the retained half-pitch sockets is optical diffusion and is irreducible by any addressing scheme, since the 1064nm spatial resolution floor at cortical depth is a ~26mm 10-90% edge-spread function.
zone.name: Frontal Right (excl. midline)

zone.description: Frontal Left with the three frontal midline sockets (2, 13, 29) omitted; every other Frontal Left socket is kept, including the half-pitch ones beside the midline. A DIS-INCLUSION zone in the sense of the PR #210 membership ruling. Exists for clinical-05-pbm-anxiety-wang (Wang 2023, left DLPFC only), which the lateralized-protocol audit flagged: the midline modules would put half their cortical energy into the right hemisphere (NP-OPT-PSF-001 §4). The residual spill from the retained half-pitch sockets has not been modelled for this zone or for 820nm.
zone.name: Frontal Left (excl. midline)

zone.description: Head sites for Parkinson's transcranial PBM. DERIVED FROM THE PROTOCOL, not from lobe boundaries: clinical-08-pbm-parkinsons.npps targets the head 'bilateral, midline over SMA/motor' (pbm_neuro_protocols.md §8, Grade C — Liebert 2021/2024) and explicitly not the whole vault, because whole-head irradiation would over-deliver well beyond the evidence. Primary motor cortex is the precentral gyrus at the central sulcus; the supplementary motor area is medial frontal just anterior to it. Row r4 sits at 39.3% of the nasion-inion arc — the precentral motor strip — and is the only row over the motor representation. This zone is that row (width 9) minus its two temporal sockets (25, 33), which are lateral to the motor representation: 26, 27, 28 (left), 29 (midline, over the SMA), 30, 31, 32 (right). Balanced bilateral with a midline site, exactly as the protocol requires. PROVISIONAL — final registration depends on gate REG-1 (NP-HEX-ZM-001 §7). Confirm against the shell CAD before any clinical dosing claim.
zone.name: Motor / SMA
